messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-09-09
messages.body:
+1 (binding)

Verified the 2026-09-09 wave (38 providers) against
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/providers/2026-09-09

* Folder complete: 231 files = 38 x 6 + source trio; 77 .sha512 / 77 .asc,
  no double-extension leftovers.
* SHA512: 77/77.
* Signatures: 77/77 good, all on your key
  1E7A857875E0EE49DB99E4431B17D6C5938CED00 (present in KEYS).
* Reproducible builds: 77/77 byte-identical -- 76 wheels and sdists rebuilt
  from the providers/2026-09-09 tag
  (209e34c5022a78c7691ac68a50f60d976242e17d), plus the source tarball.
* Licences: Apache RAT 0.18 -- 0 unapproved, 0 unknown (10146 standard
  files, all AL2.0).
* All 38 rc tags point at the wave commit; 38/38 pyproject versions match
  their changelog tops; 38/38 PyPI rc pages resolve with wheel and sdist.

I also tested my own changes in this wave (akeyless, fab, keycloak -- all
security hardening), confirmed each is present in the shipped wheels rather
than only at the tag, and ran their unit tests: 520 passed, 1 skipped.
Ticked on https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/72902

One non-blocking observation, pre-existing and unchanged since the
2026-08-18 wave: the source tarball ships two OFL-1.1 web fonts at
registry/public/fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2 and
registry/public/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin.woff2 while the root LICENSE
is bare AL2.0 with no third-party section. They are source-tarball only --
no provider wheel contains them -- so this is a LICENSE follow-up rather
than a reason to re-cut.

Cheers,
Jarek
